captions.detailed: An elegant arc floor lamp featuring a heavy, light-gray rectangular marble base with subtle dark grain lines. A long, slender metallic silver post curves gracefully in an arch, pivoting forward and backward on a black revolute hinge at the base mount. At the tip of the curved post, a cone-shaped black lamp shade is mounted via a secondary bracket, allowing the shade to tilt on its own revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an articulated arc floor lamp. It should feature a heavy rectangular marble base, a long curved silver post that pivots forward and backward at its base connection, and a conical black shade at the far end of the arc that tilts independently on its own hinge.
captions.factory: The base is constructed using a flat box primitive with a marble texture. The pivot mount at the base is built with a combination of box and cylinder primitives, establishing a revolute joint for the main post. The curved post is generated by sweeping a circular cross-section along a parameterized arc path. At the end of the arc, a second hinge bracket is modeled using small box and pin components, followed by a conical shell primitive representing the shade, which is connected via a second revolute joint.
